mn142:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
mn142:2.1: Atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī navaṃ dussayugaṃ ādāya yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
mn142:2.2: Idaṃ me, bhante, navaṃ dussayugaṃ Bhagavantaṃ uddissa sāmaṃ kantaṃ sāmaṃ vāyitaṃ;
mn142:2.3: tam me, bhante, Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn142:2.4: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā Mahāpajāpatiṃ Gotamiṃ etad avoca:--
mn142:2.6: saṃghe te dinne ahañ c' eva pūjito bhavissāmi saṃgho cāti.
mn142:2.7: Dutiyam pi kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
mn142:2.10: Dutiyam pi kho Bhagavā Mahāpajāpatiṃ Gotamiṃ etad avoca:--
mn142:3.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: --
mn142:3.2: Paṭiggaṇhātu, bhante, Bhagavā Mahāpajāpatiyā Gotamiyā navaṃ dussayugaṃ;
mn142:3.3: bahūpakārā, bhante, Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī Bhagavato mātucchā āpādikā posikā khīrassa dāyikā
mn142:3.5: Bhagavā pi, bhante, bahūpakāro Mahāpajāpatiyā Gotamiyā;
mn142:3.6: Bhagavantaṃ, bhante, āgamma Mahāpajapatī Gotamī Buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, saṃghaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā.
mn142:3.7: Bhagavantaṃ, bhante, āgamma Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratā kāmesu micchācārā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā.
mn142:3.8: Bhagavantaṃ, bhante, āgamma Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā, dhamme aveccappasādena samannagatā, saṃghe aveccappasādena samannāgatā, ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgatā.
mn142:3.9: Bhagavantaṃ, bhante, āgamma Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī dukkhe nikkaṅkhā dukkhasamudaye nikkaṅkhā dukkhanirodhe nikkaṅkhā dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya nikkaṅkhā.
mn142:3.10: Bhagavā pi, bhante, bahūpakāro Mahāpajāpatiyā Gotamiyā ti. Evam etaṃ, Ānanda;
mn142:4.2: Yaṃ h', Ānanda, puggalo puggalaṃ āgamma Buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, saṃghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, imass', Ānanda, puggalassa iminā puggalena na suppatikāraṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ
mn142:4.4: Yaṃ h', Ānanda, puggalo puggalaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti musāvādā paṭivirato hoti surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti, imass', Ānanda, puggalassa iminā puggalena na suppatikāraṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ . . . --
mn142:4.6: Yaṃ h', Ānanda, puggalo puggalaṃ āgamma Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, dhamme . . . sīlehi samannāgato hoti, imass', Ānanda, puggalassa iminā puggalena na suppatikāraṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ . . . --
mn142:4.8: Yaṃ h', Ānanda, puggalo puggalaṃ āgamma dukkhe nikkaṅkho hoti dukkhasamudaye nikkaṅkho hoti dukkhanirodhe nikkaṅkho hoti dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya nikkaṅkho hoti, imass', Ānanda, puggalassa iminā puggalena na suppatikāraṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ . . . --
mn142:5.1: Cuddasa kho pan' im', Ānanda, pāṭipuggalikā dakkhiṇā.
mn142:6.1: Tatr', Ānanda, tiracchānagate dānaṃ datvā sataguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā; puthujjanadussīle dānaṃ datvā sahassaguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā; puthujjanasīlavante dānaṃ datvā satasahassaguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā; bāhirake kāmesu vītarāge dānaṃ datvā koṭisatasahassaguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā; sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanne dānaṃ datvā asaṅkheyyā appameyyā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkheyyā. Ko panā vādo sotāpanne? Ko pana vādo sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanne? Ko pana vādo sakadāgāmissa? Ko pana vādo anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanne? Ko pana vādo anāgāmissa? Ko pana vādo arahattaphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanne? Ko pana vādo Tathāgatasāvake arahante? Ko pana vādo Paccekabuddhe? Ko pana vādo Tathāgate arahante Sammāsambuddhe?
mn142:7.1: Satta kho pan' im', Ānanda, saṃghagatā dakkhiṇā.
mn142:7.11: Ettakā me bhikkhū ca bhikkhuniyo ca saṃghato uddissathāti dānaṃ deti;--
mn142:7.13: Ettakā me bhikkhū saṃghato uddissathāti dānaṃ deti;--
mn142:7.15: Ettakā me bhikkhuniyo saṃghato uddissathāti dānaṃ deti; --
mn142:8.1: Bhavissanti kho pan', Ānanda, anāgatamaddhānaṃ gotrabhuno kāsāvakaṇṭhā dussīlā pāpadhammā
mn142:8.2: tesu dussīlesu saṃghaṃ uddissa dānaṃ dassanti.
mn142:8.3: Tadā p' ahaṃ. Ānanda, saṃghagataṃ dakkhiṇaṃ asaṅkheyyaṃ appameyyaṃ vadāmi,
mn142:8.4: na tvevāhaṃ, Ānanda, kenaci pariyāyena saṃghagatāya dakkhiṇāya pāṭipuggalikaṃ dānaṃ mahapphalataraṃ vadāmi.
mn142:9.3: Atth', Ānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
mn142:9.4: Atth', Ānanda, dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati no dāyakato.
mn142:9.5: Atth', Ānanda, dakkhiṇā n' eva dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
mn142:9.6: Atth', Ānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato c' eva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca.
mn142:10.1: Kathañ c', Ānanda, dakkhiṇa dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato?
mn142:10.2: Idh', Ānanda, dāyako hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, paṭiggāhakā honti dussīlā pāpadhammā;--
mn142:10.3: evaṃ kho, Ānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
mn142:11.1: Kathañ c', Ānanda, dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati no dāyakato?
mn142:11.2: Idh', Ānanda, dāyako hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo, paṭiggāhakā honti sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā --
mn142:11.3: evaṃ kho, Ānanda, dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati no dāyakato.
mn142:12.1: Kathañ c', Ānanda, dakkhiṇā n' eva dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato?
mn142:12.2: Idh', Ānanda, dāyako ca hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo, paṭiggāhakā ca honti dussīlā pāpadhammā; --
mn142:12.3: evaṃ kho, Ānanda, dakkhiṇā n' eva dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
mn142:13.1: Kathañ c', Ānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato c' eva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca?
mn142:13.2: Idh', Ānanda, dāyako ca hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, paṭiggāhakā ca honti sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā;--
mn142:13.3: evaṃ kho, Ānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato c' eva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca.
mn142:13.4: Imā kho, Ānanda, catasso dakkhiṇāvisuddhiyo ti.
mn142:14.2: idaṃ vatvā Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā:--
mn142:14.14: Sā dakkhiṇā n' ev' ubhato visujjhati.
mn142:14.18: Taṃ ve dānaṃ vipullaphalan ti brūmi.
mn142:14.22: Taṃ ve dānaṃ āmisadānaṃ vipulan ti
